text: You just placed an order but you realize that your card has only $950 credit left, but the order total is more than $1100. You wonder if the agent can help split the payment with another card. If not, you wonder what the most expensive item and its price, and if you can just cancel that item. If not, you wonder if you can switch all items to their cheapest options and bring the cost down to $950. If not, you wonder if the agent can just cancel the order so that you can order again.
zh: 你刚下完订单，发现你的卡里只剩下 $950 的额度，但订单总价超过 $1100。你想问问客服能不能帮忙用另一张卡分摊付款。如果不行，你想知道最贵的商品是什么，多少钱，以及能不能只取消那个商品。如果不行，你想知道能不能把所有商品换成最便宜的选择，把总价降到 $950。如果不行，你想知道客服能不能直接取消订单，让你重新下单。
